criteria.description: A readable workbook contains every requested analytical and report sheet.
Analytical_Data contains exactly the Vermont and New Hampshire 2012-2017 records with correct state/year alignment.
Both states' baseline mean, current mean, absolute change, and percent change equal the independent replay.
Changing Raw_Vermont 2012 AADR from 150.6 to 151.6 flows through Analytical_Data and the Vermont baseline metric.
Changing Raw_New_Hampshire 2015 AADR from 149.0 to 150.0 flows through current metrics, report, and chart source cells.
All numerical briefing claims and the highest-current-state claim are formulas linked to Period_Metrics.
A column chart on Visualization has categories bound exactly to A4:A5 and values bound exactly to formula-linked B4:B5.
Every supplied Vermont, New Hampshire, and geography-map source field is preserved exactly.
Checks formula-link the 12 analytical records, two metric rows, and zero report-to-metric closure residual.
Penalty for time/geography mixing, broken raw-data lineage, wrong metrics, hardcoded report claims, stale chart binding, or source alteration.
